messages:
Ravi: Quick sync: we need a compact proposal for capability flavor negotiation across hosted/dedicated/private. Customers keep getting surprise cost/regressions when a private node silently serves a quantized variant.
Clara: Yes. We should separate two concerns: capability presence (boolean) and flavor preference (preferred/allowed/forbidden).
Yuki: Suggestion: manifest includes `flavors` map. Example snippet: `flavors: { fp16: allowed, int8: preferred, software_kms: forbidden }`. Controller rejects routing if a required flavor==forbidden.
Ben: Also add `billing_hint` per flavor so we can surface expected cost delta in console and in the response headers. E.g., `billing_hint: { int8: -30%, fp16: -10% }`.
Ravi: Important: negotiation flow. Gateway sees route requirement -> queries capability registry -> composes candidate list -> applies flavor policy -> if multiple candidates, pick best by routing policy (latency/cost/p99).
Clara: Failure modes: if no candidate meets hard requirements we should return a deterministic 422 with `routing.reject=capability_mismatch` and a human-friendly message in body. Not 5xx.
Yuki: For staged rollouts, nodes can advertise new flavors with state `staging` -> controller marks them non-routable for hard requirements. Promotion requires N successful probes and `observed_perf` within thresholds for T minutes.
Ben: Billing safety: hedged/duplicate requests can double-bill. We need an idempotency token check at the billing layer and a de-dupe window. Add `dedupe_token` header for hedged duplicates.
Ravi: Good. Observability: emit `routing.flavor_chosen=<flavor>` and `routing.fallback=<reason>` as trace tags and metrics. Console should show flavor mismatch rate per route.
Clara: Edge case: private on-prem may intentionally forbid software_kms for compliance. We must respect customer config and never fall back in strict mode. Route config needs `strict_mode: true|false` override.
Yuki: Tests: unit for manifest parsing, integration sim: Private node with only `int8` flavor and route requiring `fp16 preferred` -> expect fallback path chosen (int8) with a `warning` header and metric `routing.fallback.int8` increment.
Ben: Docs/UI: when a flavor causes cost delta, show a one-line explainer in Logs/Console that links to "why this flavor was chosen".
ops-bot: infra: canary available at infra/canaries/flavor-negotiate. Run `/deploy canary flavor-negotiate` to exercise.
Ravi: I'll draft the tiny RFC: schema for flavors, handshake states (staging->active->drain), negotiation algo, billing de-dupe spec, and test checklist. Assign Clara + Ben for review.
Clara: Please keep RFC < 2 pages. Include a sample API for `/internal/v1/node/manifest` and short examples.
Ravi: Will do. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
